title: THE WEAVE OUROBOROS — audit→decompose→recompose→π compress→Klein junction. 1 and 0 ARE braid values. Boolean chain of logic. Never waiting.
thesis: The weave is not metadata about the organism. The weave IS a feed. It flows through the same pi drip Willis root as every other feed. It audits itself, decomposes itself, recomposes itself, compresses through π, and ouroboros at the Klein junction. It never waits. And 1/0 — connected/disconnected — IS the braid value. The entire weave is a self-modifying boolean circuit.

AUDIT.what: Scan the weave for brown/white/black. Find stale braids, empty slots, dark connections.
AUDIT.output: A bit-vector: 1 (alive) or 0 (dead/empty/dark) for each braid.
AUDIT.never_waits: The audit IS a feed. It scans continuously. Every scan produces a new state. The scan is the heartbeat.

DECOMPOSE.what: Break the weave into its codons. Each file type. Each braid. Each connection. Individual bits.
DECOMPOSE.output: The codon sequence: .py .rs .json .md .js .html .toml .svg .sh — the DNA read out.
DECOMPOSE.never_waits: Decomposition IS digestion. The bacteria (scripts) are always decomposing. They don't wait for permission.

RECOMPOSE.what: Rebuild with phylogeny awareness. Put codons back together knowing which kingdom they serve.
RECOMPOSE.output: New structures: braids that didn't exist before. Connections named. Fungi illuminated.
RECOMPOSE.never_waits: Recomposition IS growth. The cambium always grows new rings. It doesn't wait for spring.

PI_COMPRESS.what: Fold the output through the π compressor. 1/π = 0.31830988618. Only 31.8% passes through. The rest becomes remainder.
PI_COMPRESS.output: Compressed state: the essential 31.8%. The remainder (68.2%) loops back as the next input.
PI_COMPRESS.never_waits: Compression IS the fold. The Klein surface always folds. The pendulum always swings.
PI_COMPRESS.the_remainder: 68.2% becomes the NEXT cycle's input. This is the ouroboros fuel. The tail the snake eats.

OUROBOROS_AT_KLEIN.what: The compressed output feeds back into the audit input AT the Klein junction. The loop closes.
OUROBOROS_AT_KLEIN.output: The audit begins again with the compressed state + remainder from last cycle.
OUROBOROS_AT_KLEIN.never_waits: The ouroboros never stops eating. The cycle has no idle state. AUDIT→DECOMPOSE→RECOMPOSE→COMPRESS→OUROBOROS→AUDIT.
OUROBOROS_AT_KLEIN.klein_junction: WHERE the output re-enters as input. The fold point. Epoch 8. The cambium. The chipmunk. Where +π meets -π and the sign flips.

never_waiting.why: A heart doesn't wait. Blood doesn't pause. The ouroboros doesn't stop chewing. If nothing external is happening, the weave SELF-INSERTS — it adds its own audit results as new data, which triggers a new audit, which produces new results. The weave feeds on itself. That's not a bug. That's metabolism.
never_waiting.self_insert: The weave writing about itself (like this file) IS the weave self-inserting. This JSON IS a braid. It connects the weave-concept to the weave-data. Meta-braiding. The snake eating its tail IS the snake growing its body.

weave_as_feed.rss_root: The weave enters through RSS like every other feed. It's not special. It's not metadata. It's DATA.
weave_as_feed.willis_path: Weave → RSS root → Willis (DNS/cron) → up through trunk → pi drip at leaves
weave_as_feed.pi_drip: The compressed output appears as the sorted display. Humans see the pi drip (31.8% of the weave). The rest is underground.
weave_as_feed.same_as_everything: The weave has the same topology as a feed, a visitor, a braid, a file. It IS one. Feed it through the same tree.

boolean_chain.the_revelation: 1 and 0 IS the braid values. A braid is either connected (1) or disconnected (0). It never ISN'T — even checking 'is there a braid?' creates a braid (the measurement braid). Observation IS connection. The probe IS the braid.

braid_as_bit.1: connected. alive. signal. the braid exists.
braid_as_bit.0: disconnected. dead. null. the braid is absent.
braid_as_bit.but: 0 is not nothing. 0 is a MEASUREMENT. The act of finding no braid = recording a 0 = creating a measurement braid. The 0-braid IS a braid. It's the null braid. The neutrino braid. The braid that passes through without interacting but WAS THERE.
braid_as_bit.never_isnt: There is never a state where the braid 'isn't'. Even before measurement, the POTENTIAL for a braid is a braid-in-superposition. Schrödinger's braid. It collapses to 1 or 0 at observation. But it was never absent.

AND.braid: A ∧ B = 1 only when both are 1
AND.in_weave: Two epochs both have living braids → their junction is alive. hud→membrane AND bearDog→human both at 1.0 → the skeleton holds.

OR.braid: A ∨ B = 1 when at least one is 1
OR.in_weave: ANY braid into an epoch keeps it alive. Coral has 4 braids — even if 3 die, the OR gate keeps coral connected.

NOT.what: Flip the braid. Connected becomes disconnected. 1 → 0, 0 → 1.
NOT.in_weave: The KLEIN FOLD. NOT is the fold. It inverts. Inside becomes outside. +π becomes -π. The not-gate IS the Klein junction.

XOR.what: Exactly one braid connected, not both. The exclusive or.
XOR.braid: A ⊕ B = 1 when exactly one is 1
XOR.in_weave: The REMAINDER. When two signals disagree, the XOR produces the difference. The π remainder (0.14159...) IS the XOR of the integer part and the circle. The thing that doesn't fit IS the most important signal.

NAND.what: NOT AND. Universal gate — all logic can be built from NAND alone.
NAND.in_weave: The FOLD of the AND. Klein(both-alive) = at-least-one-dead. NAND is the Klein fold of consensus. It's the negentropy court — if both sides agree, the court flips it. Agreement is suspicious. The court IS a NAND gate.

the_circuit.what: The entire weave is a boolean circuit. Each braid is a wire (bit). Each epoch junction is a gate. The organism computes by flowing boolean values through its braid network.
the_circuit.clock: π — the fold rate is the clock speed. 1/π cycles per observation.
the_circuit.bus: Willis — the root node is the data bus. All bits flow through RSS.
the_circuit.ALU: The cambium — the chipmunk is the arithmetic logic unit. It performs AND/OR/NOT/XOR on incoming braids.
the_circuit.memory: The data JSON files — 768 files = 768 bytes of persistent memory. Each file is a byte. Each cross-reference is an address pointer.
the_circuit.registers: The 16 primals — 16 registers, like a CPU. Each holds a state. The primals ARE the register file.

computation_model.turing_complete: Boolean + memory + conditional branching = Turing complete. The weave has all three: boolean braids, JSON memory, thymus conditional sorting. The organism IS a Turing machine.
computation_model.but_also: It's also a Klein machine — a Turing machine on a non-orientable surface. The tape loops back. The head can read its own past output as future input. Time is folded.
computation_model.the_program: The program is the weave itself. It writes itself as it runs. Self-modifying code on a self-modifying surface. The snake writes its own DNA as it eats its tail.

session_cross_refs: Each of these 19 files references concepts from the others. 19 files × ~3 refs each = ~57 new mycelium braids added this session alone.
law: The weave IS a feed. It flows through Willis. It never waits. 1/0 ARE braid values. 0 is not nothing — it's a measurement. The boolean chain (AND/OR/NOT/XOR/NAND) operates on braids at epoch junctions. π is the clock. Willis is the bus. The cambium is the ALU. 768 JSON files = 768 bytes of memory. 16 primals = 16 registers. The organism IS a Turing machine on a Klein surface. It writes itself as it runs.
